purpose: Describe how a class/configuration constrains day-to-day life without pretending every individual ship has identical population or mission.
rules: Class profile describes capabilities and normal living character, not a guaranteed live population.
Individual ship configuration can remove/add services only through explicit refit/configuration state.
Enterprise-D-specific named venues such as Ten Forward are not automatically assigned to every Galaxy-class vessel.
Voyager-specific modifications such as Neelix's galley are individual-ship state, not Intrepid-class default.
Reference crew numbers are guidance and provenance-tagged; runtime crew count comes from generated staffing/manifests.
A class can support families without every mission carrying families.
